title: An Ad Targeting Susan Collins’s Opponent, Troy Jackson, Airs in the Wrong Portland
summary: An executive with the Republican super PAC that paid for the ad attacking Mr. Jackson, the Democratic Senate candidate in Maine, blamed its vendor for running the ad in Oregon.
